hero.title: Extending a Helping Hand to Those in Need
hero.description: Twamul Miskin is committed to supporting people facing hardship, including people experiencing poverty, homelessness, and the consequences of natural disasters.
hero.note: Your generosity can help bring care, dignity, and relief to people in need.
hero.highlightDescription: Together, we can work toward a community where people facing hardship are treated with care, dignity, and respect.

about.title: About Twamul Miskin
about.description: Twamul Miskin is an Islamic charitable initiative focused on helping people who need support during difficult circumstances. The foundation aims to connect generosity with meaningful assistance for vulnerable members of the community.
about.purpose: Through charitable contributions and community support, our aim is to help address essential needs and respond to hardship with compassion and responsibility.
about.mission: To support people facing poverty, homelessness, and emergencies caused by natural disasters, while encouraging compassion, generosity, and responsibility within the community.
about.vision: A caring community where people in difficult circumstances can access support and where charitable giving is handled responsibly and with dignity.

poor.title: Support for People in Need
poor.description: Help people and families experiencing financial hardship meet essential needs.

disaster.title: Natural Disaster Relief
disaster.description: Support relief efforts for communities affected by floods, storms, and other natural disasters.

homeless.title: Support for Homeless People
homeless.description: Help people without stable housing access essential assistance and care.

faq.title: How Can We Help You?
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Twamul Miskin and supporting its charitable work.

items.question: What is Twamul Miskin?
items.answer: Twamul Miskin is an Islamic charitable initiative that aims to support people facing poverty, homelessness, and hardship caused by natural disasters.

items.question: Who can benefit from the charitable fund?
items.answer: The fund is intended to help people in need, including vulnerable individuals and families, people experiencing homelessness, and communities affected by natural disasters. Assistance depends on the needs identified and the resources available.

items.question: What types of donations can I make?
items.answer: You can explore the available donation options on our Donate page. Please review the listed categories and any guidance provided before making a contribution.

items.question: How will my donation be used?
items.answer: Donations are intended to support the foundation's charitable purposes. Information about specific fund allocations and expenditure should be published when verified records are available.

items.question: Can I donate for emergency relief?
items.answer: When an emergency relief campaign is available, you can review its details and the stated needs before contributing.

items.question: How can I learn more or ask a question?
items.answer: Visit our About page to learn about the foundation, or use the Contact page to get in touch with the team.
